# Pranav Garg — Legal Counsel for Agencies

> Independent advocate (Bar Council of Delhi) providing on-call legal counsel to marketing, PR, influencer, ORM and event agencies on a fixed monthly retainer. Based in New Delhi, serving agencies across India. Contracts reviewed within 48 hours, no per-matter law-firm billing.

## What this is
Pranav Garg is a commercial-disputes lawyer at Karanjawala & Co., New Delhi, who also acts as independent legal counsel to agencies. The retainer model gives creative and marketing businesses an on-call lawyer for one fixed monthly fee instead of expensive per-matter law-firm billing.

## Who it's for
- Digital marketing agencies
- Online reputation management (ORM) companies
- Influencer and talent agencies
- Event management companies

## Services
- Client MSAs & SOWs — scope, liability caps, payment terms
- Influencer & talent agreements — exclusivity, usage rights, termination
- Vendor, venue & production contracts — indemnities, cancellation, force majeure
- IP & usage rights — assignment, licensing, portfolio rights
- Advertising compliance — ASCI codes, DoCA endorsement rules
- Recoveries & legal notices — demand notices, negotiated settlements
- Employment & freelancer contracts — non-solicit, moonlighting, IP capture
- Disputes & arbitration — from first notice to final hearing

## The retainer
- One fixed monthly fee, from ₹15,000/month, scoped to contract volume
- Contracts reviewed and returned within 48 hours; quick questions answered same day
- Includes contract review & drafting, templates, a monthly legal health check and dispute first-response
- Litigation or arbitration, if needed, at preferred rates

## Experience
Supreme Court of India (up to a 9-judge Constitution Bench), international and domestic arbitration, NCLT and NCLAT. Trained at Dr. B.R. Ambedkar National Law University (B.A. LL.B. Hons., CGPA 9.0/10). Advocate, Bar Council of Delhi (D/8794/2024).
